title: Outcome Ledger
description: JSON artifact that records one Phase 9 research out-of-sample outcome for one candidate and evaluation window. The schema validates local shape only; reference resolution, cross-field datetime ordering, and consumer inference floors are deferred to validators, query-layer integrity views, or later consumers.

lifecycle_state_during_window.description: Lifecycle state occupied by the candidate during the evaluation window. Outcome-ledger v1 supports research outcomes only.

evaluation_window_start.description: Evaluation-window start. Null is allowed when the source EXP/REP record explicitly preserves the current no-formal-split convention.

evaluation_window_end.description: Evaluation-window end. Null is allowed when the source EXP/REP record explicitly preserves the current no-formal-split convention.

outcome_kind.description: Outcome class recorded by this ledger entry. Outcome-ledger v1 supports research OOS outcomes only.

metrics.description: REP-derived out-of-sample metric object. Field names mirror committed REP metrics without inventing outcome-ledger-specific metric names.

data_provenance.description: Source data or source artifact basis for the evaluation window.

derivation_record.description: Disclosure of how the outcome-ledger entry was derived.

pipeline_version.description: Pipeline-semantics disclosure label. These labels do not imply automatic metric comparability across versions.

linked_artifacts.description: Related artifact identifiers or repo-relative paths. Resolution is deferred to WP-9l validator/query-layer work.

retrospective_flag.description: True when the outcome-ledger entry is a retrospective derivation from already committed evidence.

linked_advisory_artifacts.description: Optional one-way lineage references to advisory artifacts. These links carry no execution or policy authority.

notes.description: Optional human note that does not change the recorded outcome.

retrospective_disclosure.description: Required explanation when retrospective_flag is true.

source_field.description: Source field disclosed by the REP metrics object.

window_convention.description: Window convention disclosed by the REP metrics object.

source_data_refs.description: Source data references, data-requirement strings, dataset identifiers, or artifact references available from the source EXP/REP evidence.

source_data_window_start.description: Source-data window start when available from committed evidence; null otherwise.

source_data_window_end.description: Source-data window end when available from committed evidence; null otherwise.

source_data_notes.description: Optional provenance note copied or summarized from committed source artifacts.

derivation_method.description: Method used to derive the outcome-ledger entry.

source_artifact_path.description: Repo-relative path to the source artifact.

derivation_timestamp.description: Timezone-qualified ISO datetime when this outcome entry was derived.

derivation_tool_version.description: Optional derivation tool version when a later helper exists.
